title: Enforce controller ownership and keep advice distinct from approval
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `owner`, store `memory`). Possession of a run id alone must not confer control. An intruder controller cannot resume; ordinary guidance cannot satisfy final-approval authority — that remains `fangore_insp_approval_interrupt`. Tracks R-IOC-AUTH. He walks product steps (start, answer, inspect, start, answer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-07]
implementation: `LeaseControllerAuth` / `GeneratorControllerAuth` on resume/cancel; `requested_authority=final_approval` raises PermissionError pointing hosts at ApprovalInterrupt.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
